variables.name: all 855 columns ending in _filled
variables.meaning: High-dimensional numeric engineered-feature family. Names encode concepts such as counts, amounts, ratios, scores, login/device signals, punishment/risk signals, category/location signals, and lookback windows including 30d, 90d, 180d, and 365d. The _filled suffix indicates a filled representation, but fill rules are not supplied.

variables.name: all 855 columns ending in _filled

structure.description: input_1.csv and input_2.csv are row partitions with identical 856-column headers. Rows are record-grained and keyed by rowkey; feature columns align by exact header name across files.

uncertainties: No target column, partition role, units, or feature-generation documentation is included.
The _filled suffix does not reveal whether original missingness used constants, model-based imputation, or another rule.
Opaque families such as x*_filled and f*_filled have no recoverable semantic labels.
annotation_notes: Feature names often contain a metric token such as cnt, amt, ratio, score, fee, or days and a lookback suffix; these tokens are more informative than column position.
The 855 engineered columns are grouped because they constitute one regular wide feature matrix; their exact names remain available in the CSV header.
